project.name: Trip Hop Minimal Aggressive Club Mix

arrangement.notes: Arrangement features minimal instrumentation emphasizing aggressive vibe with club energy profile. Sample layers structured using micro chops, phrase chops, reverse chops, vocal chops, and stutter chops on vocal channels.

event_markers.label: Vocal chops intro
event_markers.reason: Introduce vocal chops with micro and phrase chops sample layers

event_markers.label: Reverse chops effect
event_markers.reason: Add reverse chops effect to vocal and fx layers for bridge section atmosphere

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic foundation with aggressive club beat
track_roles.chords: Minimal harmonic support with filtered textures
track_roles.vocal: Vocal chops showcasing sample layering techniques
track_roles.fx: Atmospheric effects using reverse and stutter chops

sensei_drum.brief: Generate minimal but aggressive drum patterns suitable for club energy, focused on tight rhythmic hits.

bass_generator.brief: Produce a driving but minimal bassline that complements the aggressive mood and club energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Create minimal chord textures that support the mood without overcrowding the arrangement.

melody_generator.brief: Add sparse melodic elements that add interest but maintain minimalism.

ai_designer.brief: Arrange the sections with dynamic energy curve, utilizing sample chop techniques on vocal layers.

presetor.brief: Apply preset sounds optimized for trip hop minimal style with aggressive, club energy character.

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement segmentation and energy flow to ensure coherent and engaging structure.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance mix emphasizing clarity of chops and aggressive elements, maintaining club energy presence.
